one_liner: Team chat and collaboration messaging platform by Zoho

evidence.claim: API authenticates via OAuth 2.0 with Bearer tokens
evidence.quote: Zoho Cliq API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication. OAuth 2.0 is an industry-standard protocol specification that enables third-party applications

evidence.claim: Self-serve app registration via Zoho API Console yields Client ID and Secret
evidence.quote: Upon successful registration of your application, you will receive a Client ID and Client Secret. These credentials are used to obtain an access token

evidence.claim: API support is included on all plans, including free tier
evidence.quote: | API support | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

evidence.claim: Official vendor MCP server exists for AI agent access
evidence.quote: Any AI model or agent can use our official MCP server to access your Cliq data and do:

evidence.claim: Broad REST API surface spanning chats, messages, bots, commands, widgets, schedulers
evidence.quote: v3 introduces CRUD API endpoints for bots, slash commands, message actions, widgets, schedulers, and more, which were not available in v2.

notes: OAuth endpoints are multi-datacenter (accounts.zoho.{dc}); use api_domain from token response. API v3 is recommended; v2 remains fully supported with same OAuth tokens. Downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec available. Official MCP server configured via Zoho MCP service with a generated MCP URL and API key regeneration. API support listed on all plans including the free tier.
